headline: Frequent Rework of Searcher Module
diagnosis: The searcher module is undergoing frequent rework due to inconsistencies and issues related to binary detection and encoding handling. Recent commits indicate a pattern of fixes and enhancements, particularly around the search functionality and its interaction with different data types.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the binary detection logic to identify any edge cases or bugs that may be causing repeated issues.
Standardize the encoding handling across the searcher module to ensure consistent behavior, especially when dealing with UTF-8 and UTF-16 data.
Implement comprehensive unit tests focused on the search functionality and binary detection to catch issues early in the development cycle.
Establish a code review process specifically for changes to the searcher module to ensure that all modifications are scrutinized for potential impacts.
owner_hint: Assign ownership of the searcher module to a dedicated team member to reduce bus factor.
